links.outcome: Correctness and clinical usefulness of AI explanations rated by clinician panel
links.effect: Model explanations agreed with expert clinicians in 74.2% of cases and segmentations in 83.3%. Panel rated explanations useful in 75.0% and segmentations useful in 72.4%.
links.quote: A panel of clinicians evaluated segmentations as useful in 72.4% of cases and explanations as useful in 75.0% of cases.

unlisted_practices: Using AI explanations to gauge operator competence and discriminate between clinicians' experience levels

screen.reason: Empirical validation of an explainable AI model for fetal growth ultrasound scans evaluated prospectively by clinician end-users across institutions, focusing on model correctness, explanation usefulness, and operator evaluation rather than a comparative trial of an operational guardrail.
